info.title: BhoomiScan AI – Sovereign Land Record Digitization & Verification Engine
info.description: Production-grade sovereign AI platform designed for Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2026. Transforms legacy, faded, handwritten, and multilingual Indian land records into DILRMP 2.0 and ULPIN-compliant verified digital registries with automated OCR, Grok LLM extraction, rapidfuzz duplicate fraud detection, and human-in-the-loop verification.

post.description:
Create a new user account.

- **username**: 3–100 characters, must be unique.
- **password**: minimum 8 characters (stored as bcrypt hash, never returned).
- **role**: `admin` | `verifier` | `field_officer` (default: `field_officer`).

post.summary: Exchange credentials for a JWT access token
post.description:
Authenticate and receive a Bearer token.

The token payload contains: `sub` (user id), `role`, `username`, `exp`.
Pass it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on protected endpoints.

get.summary: Return the currently authenticated user
get.description: Requires a valid Bearer token. Returns the caller's profile.

post.summary: Upload a land-record document and start async OCR + extraction
post.description:
Saves the file, creates a ``Document`` row with ``status=processing``,
enqueues the full OCR→extraction→validation pipeline as a BackgroundTask,
and returns the ``document_id`` immediately.

Poll ``GET /documents/{id}`` to watch:
``processing → needs_review | verified``

get.summary: Public verification endpoint for citizen / bank QR code scans
get.description:
Public verification endpoint that validates a land parcel ULPIN and SHA-256 seal.
Returns authenticity status without exposing sensitive personal owner data.

get.summary: Fetch document metadata + all extracted fields with confidence scores
get.description:
Returns the document metadata and its extracted fields.

While the pipeline is still running (``status=processing``) the
``extracted_fields`` list will be empty.  Poll until status changes.

get.summary: Paginated, filtered document list

patch.summary: Correct an extracted field value (verifier / admin only)
patch.description:
Update the value of a single extracted field, clear its ``is_flagged``
flag, and write entries to both ``VerificationLog`` and ``AuditTrail``.

Only ``verifier`` and ``admin`` roles are permitted.

post.summary: Mark a document as verified (blocks if any field is still flagged)
post.description:
Transitions ``status → verified``.

**Blocked** (422) if any ``ExtractedField.is_flagged == True``.
Correct all flagged fields first via
``PATCH /documents/{id}/fields/{field_name}``.

get.summary: Aggregate processing stats and district-wise breakdown
get.description:
Returns dashboard metrics (scoped to the user's uploaded documents for
field_officer role, or system-wide for admin/verifier roles):

- **total_documents**: every document uploaded
- **total_processed**: documents that have left the upload/processing phase
- **pending_review**: documents waiting for a verifier
- **verified**: documents fully signed-off
- **avg_confidence**: mean confidence score across saved ``ExtractedField`` rows
- **flagged_field_count**: fields that still need manual correction
- **district_breakdown**: per-district totals with status sub-counts

post.summary: Push a verified document to the Land Record Management System (LRMS)
post.description:
Builds the LRMS payload from the verified document's extracted fields,
logs the full payload to ``AuditTrail``, and returns a mock acceptance
response with a government-style reference ID.

**Fields included in the LRMS payload:**
owner_name, survey_number, khasra_number, khata_number, plot_area,
land_classification, ownership_details, mutation_record, registration_info,
district, tehsil, village.

When wired to a real LRMS endpoint, replace ``mock_push_lrms`` in
``app/services/integrations.py`` with the actual HTTP call — this
router and audit code stay unchanged.

post.summary: Push verified geospatial metadata to the State GIS portal
post.description:
Builds the GIS portal geo-package for the verified document,
pushes it (mocked), and logs the full payload to ``AuditTrail``.

GIS updates are typically asynchronous in real portals — the ``status``
field will read ``"queued"`` to reflect this.

post.summary: Reset database and seed 5 benchmark showcase records for live demo
post.description:
Wipes the database and seeds 5 carefully crafted evaluation scenarios:
1. **Jaipur Clean Khasra**: Verified, >90% confidence, compliant with DILRMP 2.0 and ULPIN.
2. **Jodhpur Plot Deed**: Needs review, degraded historic scan with 3 flagged fields.
3. **Jaipur Fraud Duplicate**: Needs review, 96% duplicate conflict triggering Fraud Shield.
4. **Varanasi Hindi Record**: Verified, authentic Devanagari Hindi multilingual demonstration.
5. **Sanganer In-Flight**: Processing, demonstrates live real-time SSE progress streaming.

get.summary: Inspect current demo readiness and scenario roster
get.description:
Returns the count of active documents, users, and scenarios available
for demonstration.
